title: Habit Tracker
description: Habit Tracker is a Flutter mobile application built with Dart that allows users to create, view, and manage daily habits. It displays habits in a structured data table and lets users save multiple named habit lists with associated dates. The app uses SQLite for persistent storage and follows a controller, model, and repository architecture to separate the user interface, application logic, and database operations.

title: Personal Portfolio
description: I built a responsive personal portfolio website using HTML, Sass, Bootstrap, and JavaScript to showcase my projects, skills, and experience. Project cards are generated dynamically from a JSON file, making it easy to add new work without duplicating HTML. The site features custom gradients, technology badges, and interactive modals that display additional project details.
